name: quiz-matrix-hero-silhouette
description: Guess the Hero by Silhouette: Remotion + GSAP (Pattern 1) quiz video, one round = 11 s clip

scripts.predev: npm run csv --silent && npm run mix --silent && npm run cardsounds --silent && npm run vo --silent
scripts.prerender: npm run csv --silent && npm run mix --silent && npm run vo --silent
scripts.prerender:batch: npm run csv --silent && npm run mix --silent && npm run cardsounds --silent && npm run vo --silent
scripts.prestill: npm run csv --silent && npm run mix --silent && npm run vo --silent
scripts.preanimatic: npm run csv --silent && npm run mix --silent && npm run vo --silent
scripts.prestill:board: npm run csv --silent && npm run mix --silent && npm run vo --silent
scripts.precards: npm run csv --silent && npm run cardsounds --silent && npm run vo --silent
scripts.game:dev: npm run game:prepare --silent && remotion studio src/index.js
scripts.game:still: npm run game:prepare --silent && remotion still src/index.js GameRound out/game-round.png --props='{"roundId":1}' --frame=120
scripts.game:render: npm run game:prepare --silent && remotion render src/index.js GameVideo out/game-quiz.mp4
